title: Role-based responsive portal (React + Vite) with Playwright UI validation

changes_by_evaluator: Added pw-006 (375px viewport: navigation stacks, no horizontal scroll) — responsiveness is a rubric item
Required ARIA snapshots (text, OS-independent) as the committed snapshot baseline; pixel screenshots tagged @visual and run locally only
Every journey seeds its own data through the API so specs are order-independent

api_checks.description: unknown API path is JSON 404, not the SPA

playwright_checks.description: Login routes each role to its workspace heading
AC-02/AC-03 hospital checks eligibility then submits a pre-auth and sees its status
AC-06 hospital admits, adds procedure, submits final bill (cap error shown above cap), discharges
AC-01/AC-07/AC-09 customer sees coverage, case timeline and settlement breakdown
AC-04/AC-10 adjudicator approves from queue; admin overrides an auto-rejection and sees the audit row
Responsive: at 375x800 the layout is single-column and has no horizontal scroll

ui_layer.description: UI talks only to /api via src/api.ts; no business math in the UI (money shown as server strings)
